description: A prison may be a world

participation.context: Wrote Pomfret, and left the cat where he was.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Sat on the shut Holinshed. He has no lines.
participation.name: Gib

story.body: You wrote the prison as a world and did not move Gib off the chronicle.

title: Wrote the king alone, and let the cat lie

participation.context: Wrote the death and the coffin, and did not plan the fight before the line.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote him dying in a fight, and you wrote the coffin going to the cousin.

title: Wrote him dying in a fight, and the coffin to the cousin

participation.context: Wrote the couplet and ruled the line.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Stayed on the chronicle, off the sheet.
participation.name: Gib

story.body: You finished the speech, ruled under it, and did not continue.

title: Ruled the line under the couplet

story.body: You wrote the couplet and did not add a line after it.

title: Left the couplet as the last of the page

participation.context: Wrote that the king ended, and did not count the coffer.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote the one sentence and left the coffer shut.

title: Wrote that the king ended this day

participation.context: Said the line and did not send for him.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You said there is no fool in it, and you did not tell him this morning.

title: Set the telling for after Midsummer
